boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, officially documented study settings in Weinberg Memorial Library, spanning open tables, individual carrels, quiet rooms, and collaborative spaces.

cards.title: Pro Deo Room
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up at a high-top or padded-chair table; this open, nonreservable room has soft seating and abundant natural light.
cards.short_summary: An open first-floor room with several seating styles and bright daylight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pro Deo Room offers high-top and lower study tables, padded chairs, soft seating, high natural light, and requires no reservation.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; listed as nonreservable with no reservation needed.

cards.title: Pro Deo Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, first floor
cards.notes: Choose a desktop terminal when you need a fixed workstation; the lab uses moveable padded office chairs and needs no reservation.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor desktop-computer workspace with adjustable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pro Deo Computer Lab has desktop computer terminals with moveable padded office-chair seating and requires no reservation.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; listed as nonreservable with no reservation needed.

cards.title: WML 124 A: Writing Center Room
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, first floor
cards.notes: Reserve this compact group setting for shared screen work; its semicircular table seats five and includes monitor connectivity.
cards.short_summary: A reservable five-seat room designed around one shared table and monitor connection.
cards.evidence_claim: WML 124 A has a semicircular table, five movable padded chairs, monitor connectivity, and is reservable for group study.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; listed as reservable group-study space.

cards.title: 2nd Floor Stacks Study Area
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use a divided carrel for individual focus, or take a table with power access when working from a laptop between library stacks.
cards.short_summary: A nonreservable second-floor area combining powered tables and visually divided carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2nd Floor Stacks Study Area has tables with power access, wooden chairs, and individual study carrels with visual dividers; no reservation is needed.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor; listed as nonreservable with no reservation needed.

cards.title: Brody Chair Study Area
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, second floor
cards.notes: Take an individually powered Brody chair for laptop work, or use the window-side high-top table when you want natural light.
cards.short_summary: A nonreservable second-floor zone with powered individual chairs and a window table.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brody Chair Study Area has individually powered Brody chairs, wooden tables, and a high-top table with two stools in front of a window.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor; listed as nonreservable with no reservation needed.

cards.title: WML 218: Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring solo reading or writing here for a quiet setting with fixed wooden tables and individual carrels separated by visual dividers.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet-study room with tables and divided individual carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: WML 218 is a nonreservable quiet-study space with wooden tables, fixed chairs, and individual carrels with visual dividers.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor; listed as nonreservable quiet study with no reservation needed.

cards.title: WML 319: Group Study
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use the six-chair table for a small working session, and put plans or problem sets on the wall-mounted dry-erase markerboard.
cards.short_summary: A small third-floor group room pairing a six-seat table with a markerboard.
cards.evidence_claim: WML 319 has a wooden table, six padded chairs, and a wall-mounted dry-erase markerboard; no reservation is needed.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor; listed as nonreservable and quiet study with no reservation needed.

cards.title: 3rd Floor Stacks Study Area
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, third floor
cards.notes: Pick a visually divided carrel for individual tasks, or gather at one of the five four-chair tables for a focused discussion.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor stacks area with individual carrels plus several small group tables.
cards.evidence_claim: The 3rd Floor Stacks Study Area provides rows of study carrels with visual dividers and five group-study tables with four chairs each.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor; listed as nonreservable quiet study with no reservation needed.

cards.title: 4th Floor Stacks Study Area
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Settle into a carrel, table, or soft seat depending on the task; this quiet fourth-floor area is an easy no-reservation option.
cards.short_summary: A quiet fourth-floor stacks area with carrels, tables, and soft seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4th Floor Stacks Study Area includes wooden tables, study carrels, and soft seating options, and is listed as nonreservable quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor; listed as nonreservable quiet study with no reservation needed.

cards.title: Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Choose a table, individual carrel, or soft seat in this quiet room when you want a dedicated fourth-floor study environment.
cards.short_summary: A distinct fourth-floor quiet room offering tables, carrels, and soft seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth-floor Quiet Study Room has wooden tables, wooden study carrels, and soft seating options; it is nonreservable quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor; listed as nonreservable quiet study with no reservation needed.
